sourceText:
Carnival Nutty Fudge Brownies
By: Ben Nash
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:41pm

Ingredients




1 package of Vitalicious Deep & Velvety VitaBrownie Mix
2 egg whites
1 cup water
cup ¼  of M&M'S® MINIS Baking Candy
cup ¼  crushed walnuts
1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). 2 Lightly spray a 9 x 9-inch non-stick baking pan; (We like Smart Balance Spray®). 3 Set aside. 4 In large mixing bowl combine Deep & Velvety VitaBrownie Mix, water and egg whites in large bowl. 5 Add vanilla extract. 6 Mix well. 7 Spread brownie mixture evenly. 8 Top with crushed walnuts and M&M® mini's. 9 Bake 20-27 minutes

About


Tip: This is a great dessert for the kids...it's sooo chocolaty and delicious they won't believe it's good for them! VitaBrownies are packed with the calcium,vitamins and nutrition kids need.
